claim: The repo's RE workflow is fully manual: Ghidra 12.1.2 headless analysis of a Steamless-unpacked exe with ~25 helper Java scripts (RTTI, VtableDump, FindXrefs, Trace, DumpUI, etc.); no existing community SoW framework is used.
evidence: README.md: "no existing modding framework (no SKSE analogue, no CommonLib, no Script Extender, no community loader)"
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN: repo records no game version, Steam buildid, exe hash or build check; it only states a ~112 MB x64 Steam exe with SteamStub v3.1 + Denuvo (docs/reverse-engineering.md:12,21-29). Our exe is 117732784 bytes (~112.3 MiB), consistent but not proof of 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001.
limitations: Ghidra scripts not run (per Phase 1 rules).
next_experiment: Consider reading (not running) RTTI.java/VtableDump.java as method references for our own read-only analysis.
